name: Dual Littlestone Dimension / Dual VC Dimension
details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm L^*(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{VC}^*(\mathcal H)$.
proof: Apply the standard inequality $\mathrm L(\mathcal G)\ge\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal G)$ to the dual class $\mathcal G=\mathcal H^*$.
witness_verification: For half-intervals, $\mathrm L^*=\Theta(\log n)$ while the established dual VC dimension is $1$.
